## Problem

Describe the user-visible issue or goal.

## Change

Describe the implementation and any API/transport/lifecycle implications.

## Verification

List checks and actual manual/device observations. Distinguish compilation from
real hardware validation. Explain anything not verified.

## Review

- [ ] No secrets, pairing records, personal IPAs or generated artifacts included.
- [ ] Relevant documentation/translations and vendor provenance updated.
- [ ] Input cancellation/release and uncertain-outcome behavior preserved where relevant.
